description: This file defines a custom exception class LoanOfficerUnassignmentException used within the loan account module of the Fineract platform. It extends a core domain rule exception and is thrown when a loan is not assigned to a loan officer.

classes.name: LoanOfficerUnassignmentException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a loan is not assigned to a loan officer.

methods.name: LoanOfficerUnassignmentException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific loan ID and an error message.
